title: Base Read Coils near-maximum quantity
purpose: Exercise a recognized Read Coils request at a conservative near-maximum quantity while preserving the fixed request shape and MBAP length relationship.

messages.label: Read Coils request, unit 1, start 0, quantity 125

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the frame as a Read Coils request for unit 1 and return packed coil-status data for 125 coils, or return a protocol-level exception if the addressed range is unsupported.
constraints_preserved: The frame contains a 7-byte MBAP header.
The MBAP length is 0006, matching the unit identifier and 5-byte request PDU.
Function code 01 is followed by a two-byte starting address and a two-byte quantity.
The quantity is encoded as 007d and the hex representation is lowercase without separators.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report is available. This is a conservative boundary-oriented parser seed and does not imply security impact.
